Why did you move abroad? Share your story!

I moved from Canada to the USA about six months ago after being offered a programming job at an aerospace company. This is probably the easiest form of immigration - same language, similar culture, job sorted out. It still sometimes feels like I'm on another planet though, especially since my partner and all my friends are 3 time zones away.

One thing I didn't expect was how nervous I'd get talking to immigration officials. Any time I visit home or come back, I still get so nervous talking to the border agent!! Like yes I have all my documents and everything is legit, but this person has the power to really complicate my life...

I was annoyed with the oppressive conservatism disguised as benevolence (concern trolling) that was pervasive in the US, so in 2008, I left. I went through Asia, North Africa, and South America. Married a Brazilian. Life's pretty decent.
